scope: SFX item/action/source taxonomy; primary target remains wet mouth/artificial ear

sources.title: AudioSet: surface contact
sources.supports: Distinct rub, scrape, scratch and roll labels; an event vocabulary, not a mechanical calibration.

sources.title: AudioSet: liquid
sources.supports: Separates squish, drip, splash and other liquid events. A descriptive class does not identify a microscopic sound source.

sources.title: Universal Category System
sources.supports: Public-domain SFX organization and naming. No simulator parameters or recording license are implied.

sources.title: RealImpact: A Dataset of Impact Sound Fields for Real Objects
sources.access: author project inspected; no new trial downloaded
sources.supports: 150,000 controlled impact recordings of 50 objects, with force/location/material information. Stronger relevance for dry impacts than for wet ears.

sources.title: Visually Indicated Sounds / Greatest Hits
sources.access: author project inspected; no new trial downloaded
sources.supports: Hit/scratch audiovisual examples across materials. Its example-based waveform synthesis is NOT adopted as runtime architecture.

sources.title: FSD50K
sources.access: release metadata inspected; no new trial downloaded
sources.supports: 51,197 sound clips in 200 classes; broad sound taxonomy. Audio licenses are per clip, not a blanket right to redistribute.

sources.title: SCHAEFFER sound-object dataset
sources.access: dataset card and example rows inspected; audio not downloaded
sources.supports: 1,000 designed/recorded sound objects, annotated onset, sustain, offset, pulse structure and processes. CC BY 4.0 data; code has a separate GPL license. Processed/designed sounds are not unprocessed physical trials.

sources.title: SCHAEFFER on Kaggle
sources.access: author-linked listing resolved; no readable data body or downloaded sample
sources.supports: An actual author-linked Kaggle audio resource, not the previously found channel-analytics dataset. Primary card inspected on Hugging Face.

sources.title: SonicGauss dataset card
sources.access: card inspected; no new trial downloaded
sources.supports: Processed ObjectFolder synthetic/real impact material and visual assets. Preserve synthetic-versus-measured identities; not force-to-wet-ear data.

sources.title: Cluster Haptic Texture Dataset
sources.access: descriptor plus previous paired-trial audit retained
sources.supports: Sliding motion, force, acceleration and raw/processed audio. Raw channels are contact-plus-machine and machine-reference, not two ears; do not transfer the processed spectrum blindly.

sources.title: Screeching sound of peeling tape
sources.authors: Li et al., Physical Review E 113, 025508 (2026)
sources.access: primary abstract and supplementary description inspected
sources.supports: Synchronized microphones and high-speed imaging connect the investigated tape sound to fracture-tip shock pulses. NOT evidence that saliva clicks use that mechanism.

sources.title: Universal power law in the noise from a crumpled elastic sheet
sources.supports: Recorded Mylar clicks accompany rapid configuration changes. Material, geometry and history must remain distinct from a generic hiss source.

sources.title: Spectral Modeling Synthesis
sources.supports: A signal-modeling framework, not first-principles contact acoustics. The current empirical comparator is only a pooled, phase-dependent filtered-pulse baseline, not a full SMS implementation.

sources.title: Near-field KU100 HRIR measurements
sources.access: previous measured bank and provenance retained
sources.supports: Airborne receiver responses at measured distances. Not tongue contact, sealing, or cross-head mechanical transmission.

triggers.sound_description: Intermittent wet texture, bursts, changing brightness
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Competing sources: contact friction, internal-mouth emission, changing seal. None identified by the WAV alone.
triggers.minimum_observations: Contact position/speed/load, fluid condition, both raw microphones; compare with contact-free mouth motion.
triggers.listen_for: Compare sustained detail and reversal-associated changes; reject an unrelated noise bed.
triggers.implementation: Unimplemented physical target; empirical acoustic comparator only
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.sound_description: Evolving contact texture rather than a uniformly swept filter
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Changing contact patch and deformation are candidate causes, not established labels.
triggers.minimum_observations: Contact patch video and gross motion plus raw stereo; distinguish rolling from sliding.
triggers.listen_for: Listen for action-corresponding changes without an animation suggesting them.
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.sound_description: Short clustered releases or a sticky-separation impression
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Adhesive separation, seal opening or internal-mouth sources compete. Tape fracture is only an analogy to test, not a saliva law.
triggers.minimum_observations: Synchronized separation/force and near/far microphones; compare slow peel, rapid release and dry contact.
triggers.listen_for: Does the release sound resemble the reference, with appropriate timing and decay?
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.sound_description: Quiet hold, delayed events or change after recontact
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Liquid/contact history might matter; fixed viscous damping does not identify or model it.
triggers.minimum_observations: Controlled hold durations, initial liquid amount and reset conditions.
triggers.listen_for: Reject unchanged continuous rubbing sound during an action that should be held still.
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.item: Mouth near but not touching the ear
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Could be an internal-mouth source radiating toward the ear, rather than a sound created on the pinna.
triggers.minimum_observations: Verify contact-free condition and mouth-to-microphone position.
triggers.listen_for: Compare reference character without assuming every click is tongue-to-ear contact.
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.sound_description: Soft rubbing with possible squeak or intermittency
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Reduced contact/friction models may be fittable after force/vibration measurements.
triggers.minimum_observations: Actual silicone formulation, surface topography, force, slip and microphone transfer.
triggers.listen_for: Separate interface excitation from the object/cavity ringing.
triggers.implementation: Generic fixture exists; target relation unvalidated
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.item: Glass or ceramic vessel + small striker
triggers.sound_description: Sharp onset followed by material/object-dependent decay
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Impact, elastic modes and radiation; geometry and mounting influence response.
triggers.minimum_observations: Instrumented impact, object geometry, support and microphone coordinates.
triggers.listen_for: Compare attack and resonant decay at the same impact location.
triggers.implementation: Research candidate; no new item renderer
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.item: Wood block + nail, finger or striker
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Tool/object contact and structural radiation, not just material-name EQ.
triggers.minimum_observations: Tool compliance, impact profile, mounting and grain/geometry.
triggers.listen_for: Can two impact points and two tools be distinguished?
triggers.implementation: Research candidate; no new item renderer
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.sound_description: Ringing onset, decay altered by touch
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Impact-driven modes with damping and boundary-condition changes.
triggers.minimum_observations: Impact and subsequent touch location/load plus microphone position.
triggers.listen_for: Does touching change decay rather than just volume?
triggers.implementation: Research candidate; no new item renderer
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.sound_description: Click, short rattle, or abrupt flex event
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Tap, latch and buckling are different mechanisms. Do not put them in one undifferentiated preset.
triggers.minimum_observations: Video of mechanism and impact/force history.
triggers.listen_for: Distinguish tapping the body from opening the latch.
triggers.implementation: Research candidate; no new item renderer
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.sound_description: Many fine contacts with gross stroke structure
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Distributed bristle contacts and transmission; wind/microphone rubbing can confound the capture.
triggers.minimum_observations: Brush geometry, orientation, stroke and surface contact state.
triggers.listen_for: Does stroke direction or stopping change the micro-event texture?
triggers.implementation: Research candidate; no new item renderer
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.sound_description: Sharp rough transients or sustained roughness
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Material removal and hard-edge sliding are not equivalent to soft rubbing.
triggers.minimum_observations: Contact pair, force, edge geometry, speed and surface change.
triggers.listen_for: Avoid using the same hiss with different brightness for all interactions.
triggers.implementation: Research candidate; no new item renderer
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Rapid sheet reconfiguration has experimental support in Mylar; transferring its statistics to another sheet requires measurement.
triggers.minimum_observations: Sheet dimensions/thickness, prior folds, motion and raw sound.
triggers.listen_for: Check clicks and changing activity, including history after unfolding.
triggers.implementation: Research candidate; no new item renderer
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Fracture-tip shock pulses supported in the cited tape experiment; not established for a wet tongue.
triggers.minimum_observations: Tape/substrate, peel speed/angle, force and synchronized imaging/audio.
triggers.listen_for: Use as a mechanism discrimination example, not a replacement wet-ear sound.
triggers.implementation: Research candidate; no new item renderer
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.sound_description: Squish, drainage or intermittent gas events
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Porous drainage, compliance and air interfaces are competing contributions.
triggers.minimum_observations: Liquid quantity, pore material, compression and separate air/liquid paths.
triggers.listen_for: Does the sound depend on fluid amount and compression rather than a wetness filter?
triggers.implementation: Later extension; not prioritized over primary target
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.sound_description: Isolated impacts versus a stream and container response
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Separate drop/surface events from cavity and entrained-air sound; no automatic bubble label.
triggers.minimum_observations: Liquid, landing surface/depth, drop/flow rate and microphone position.
triggers.listen_for: Distinguish individual impacts from filling/flow; do not use as saliva evidence.
triggers.implementation: Later extension; no new item renderer
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: Surface contact and tension/bending may contribute; broad labels alone do not identify the force law.
triggers.minimum_observations: Named material, tension, texture and action history.
triggers.listen_for: Compare rub versus fold at controlled gross motion.
triggers.implementation: Research candidate; no new item renderer
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.

triggers.action: Describe onset / sustain / offset / pulse pattern
triggers.sound_description: Impulse, irregular pulses, sustained layer, sharp or soft ending
triggers.mechanism_hypothesis: This is sound morphology, not a cause. Useful before assigning physical mechanisms.
triggers.minimum_observations: Acoustic event boundaries, source provenance and processing record.
triggers.listen_for: Use consistent language for what is wrong without inventing its cause.
triggers.implementation: Implemented as listening prompts and acoustic-event proposals
triggers.evidence_boundary: Hypothesis/design mapping unless the cited experiment explicitly establishes it in its own apparatus.
